name: m-begin-land

name: m-skip-land

name: m-touch-setup

name: m-stick-down

name: m-stick-run

name: m-stick-walk
eval: const t=A.state().touch; ok(t.stick.y>0.3 && t.stick.y<0.9 && !t.stick.sprint, 'a half push walks: '+JSON.stringify(t.stick)); A.teleport(-100,0,0,-90); A.step(0.2); const a=A.state(); A.step(1.0); const p=A.state(); const d=Math.hypot(p.pos.x-a.pos.x,p.pos.z-a.pos.z); ok(d>2 && d<5, 'walking speed: '+d.toFixed(2)); ({walked:+d.toFixed(2)})

name: m-stick-release
eval: const t=A.state().touch; ok(t.stick.x===0 && t.stick.y===0 && !t.stick.sprint && t.pointers===0, 'releasing the stick stops: '+JSON.stringify(t)); const a=A.state(); A.step(0.8); const p=A.state(); ok(Math.hypot(p.pos.x-a.pos.x,p.pos.z-a.pos.z)<1, 'and Mithi comes to a stop'); 1

name: m-look-drag
eval: A.step(0.1); ok(Math.abs(G.player.yaw - (P0.yaw*Math.PI/180))>0.2, 'a right-side drag turned the view: yaw '+G.player.yaw.toFixed(2)+' (was '+(P0.yaw*Math.PI/180).toFixed(2)+')'); ok(G.player.pitch<-0.002, 'dragging down looks down: '+G.player.pitch.toFixed(3)); ({yaw:G.player.yaw, pitch:G.player.pitch, touch:A.state().touch})

name: m-both-thumbs
